notes.title: New Core Pylon: The Rebel
notes.content: [p][b]New Core Pylon: [i]The Rebel[/i][/b][/p][p]The latest addition to [b]Transistor Defense[/b] is here, Introducing [b]The Rebel[/b] a core pylon that breaks the rules of traditional defense.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]No Energy Upgrades:[/b] Towers cannot be upgraded using energy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kill to Evolve:[/b] Towers now upgrade automatically after achieving a set number of kills.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This new pylon challenges you to rethink your strategy. Instead of pouring resources into upgrading towers, you’ll need to place your towers wisely and let their performance on the battlefield determine their evolution. Every placement matters, a tower that’s positioned to rack up kills will grow stronger, faster.[/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to embrace the chaos and let your towers fight for their own strength? [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Core Pylon: The Rebel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Towers cannot be upgraded with energy.[/p][/*][*][p]Towers upgrade automatically after earning a set number of kills.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tower Disarm Mechanic[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now [b]disarm towers[/b], preventing them from firing on enemies while in that state.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Audio balance and clarity improved across multiple effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various minor issues impacting stability and performance.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Core Pylon: The One
notes.content:
[p]New Core Pylon: [b][i]The One[/i][/b][/p][quote][p][i]“In the vast digital network, there is a single signal that stands above all others. Alone, it is unstoppable. Together, it is weakened. Such is the path of The One.”[/i][/p][/quote][p]The latest addition to [b]Transistor Defense[/b] is here — the [b]Core Pylon: [i]The One[/i][/b]. This pylon represents ultimate focus and singular strength, challenging you to abandon mass defenses and instead channel all of your power into [b][i]The One[/i][/b].

Gameplay Effects of [b][i]The One[/i][/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lower Tower Shop Chance[/b] – Towers are less likely to appear in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Higher Shop Costs[/b] – Those that do appear demand greater investment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]200% Damage Bonus[/b] – Field only [b]1 tower[/b] and wield overwhelming power.[/p][/*][*][p][b]50% Damage Bonus[/b] – Run with [b]2 towers[/b] and maintain a deadly edge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]0% Damage Bonus[/b] – Field [b]3 or more towers[/b] and forfeit the bonus.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]
The One[/i][/b] rewards mastery, precision, and restraint. Can you stand against the AI with just a single tower blazing at full potential?

Patch Notes[/p][list][*][p][b][i]New Core Pylon: The One[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added new music tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Music and SFX adjustments/fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Balance changes to [b]Beam, Slow, Flame, and Acid Towers[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Reduced [b]Base Module Purchase Slots[/b] to [b]8[/b] (from 10)[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and stability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Feature: GAME SEEDS in Rogue Anomaly!
notes.content:
[p]Defenders, it's time to take control of the chaos. Introducing [b]GAME SEEDS[/b] — a brand-new feature for [b]Rogue Anomaly[/b] Mode![/p][p][/p][p]With Game Seeds, you can now lock in the exact enemy waves, game map layout, and boss events for any Rogue Anomaly run. This means you can replay the same challenge as many times as you want, perfect for refining your tactics or sharing tough scenarios with friends.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why use Game Seeds?[/b]
✔️ Practice and perfect your builds
✔️ Share tough or interesting runs with others
✔️ Compete for the best solutions to the same challenge[/p][p]Master the anomaly. Break the pattern. Defend smarter.
[b]Available now — update and try it out![/b][/p][p][/p][p]#TransistorDefense #RogueAnomaly #TowerDefense #MasterTheSeed[/p]
